summary: Added sdk/economy/trades.py: SellRequest/BuyRequest, ListingSeen/ListingGone/InventoryChange/CurrencyChange observations, TradeReconciliation and reconcile_trade. Sell: requested -> listed (sale id, matching item/currency/price) -> completed (gone + item out + proceeds 1..price after listing seen) / expired (item returned) / unknown (inconsistent). Buy: requested -> completed (item in + payment >= price) / unknown. Observations before the request are ignored; inputs are validated. Exported from sdk.economy. 12 tests in tests/test_market_trades.py. Documented in docs/baseline/economy-trades.md.

contract_status_changes.before: No model distinguished a created listing from a completed trade
contract_status_changes.after: Trades are reconciled from observed listing, item and currency movements; listing creation alone is never completion

residual_risks: Whether the game escrows the item at listing time or at sale time is unverified; the reconciler accepts either, but needs the item to leave at some point after the request.
